help.intro: Little steps make a lovely zoo. You can always come back here!
help.care.title: Care for your friend
help.care.body: Click an animal, then Feed, Bring water, Pet or Clean. Your keeper walks there first. Buy food in Food; buying alone does not feed anyone. Free emergency food helps when coins are low. Click a feeder → Refill feeder: your keeper carries one portion there and hungry animals eat it themselves. Click a water trough → Fill water trough so animals can drink. Use Stop current job to choose another task; unused food and reserved planting coins are returned.
help.paths.title: Show guests the way
help.paths.body: Build → Paths, choose a path, then click clear tiles. Join every path to the entrance. Guests walk on paths. Put benches, play areas and booths beside them. Open the zoo to welcome visitors!
help.booths.title: Let the popcorn pop
help.booths.body: Build → Shops, choose a booth, then place it beside a connected path. Hungry guests buy automatically when nearby; no stock delivery is needed. A vendor walks to a booth and makes sales more rewarding. Watch Sales in Goals.
help.fences.title: Make a cosy enclosure
help.fences.body: Build → Fences, choose a fence, then click the centres of two neighbouring tiles. The fence appears on their shared edge. Repeat to close a whole area. Choose Gate for one edge so your keeper can enter. Right-click cancels; Remove fence opens an edge for free.
help.habitat.title: Welcome another animal
help.habitat.body: Close an enclosure with enough room, then Animals → choose a species → click a free tile inside. Build → Habitat paints the ground. Add food and water stations. Click your animal to see its needs; circles show what is missing. Happy animals and improvements earn stars for new species.
help.saves.title: Keep your little world
help.saves.body: Your zoo saves in this browser every 10 seconds. Settings → Export save lets you copy a backup; paste it there and choose Load save to restore it. Save before clearing browser data. Change language and sound in Settings. Right-click cancels building; the wheel zooms and the arrow button rotates.

tip.starter: Click to choose your first friend, then Start my zoo. Your choice is free.

tip.place: Click to select, then click a clear tile to place. Cost:

tip.build.shop: Hungry guests nearby buy automatically; vendors improve sales. Place beside a connected path.
tip.build.play: Children play here, feel happier and stay longer. Place beside a connected path.
tip.build.rest: Guests rest, recover energy and stay longer. Place beside a connected path.
tip.build.decor: Makes your zoo attractive and gives animals plants.
tip.build.care: Helps animal care or cleanliness. Select the placed object for its care actions.
tip.paint: Click to select, then a ground tile to paint for 1 coin. Matching ground improves habitats.
tip.fence: Select, then click two neighbouring tile centres to change their shared edge. Close a whole area and include a gate for your keeper.
tip.adopt: Select, then click a free tile in a closed enclosure. Needs at least:
tip.feed: Click to send your keeper with one food portion to this animal. Food comes from your store; hunger improves after delivery. Needed:
tip.water: Click to send your keeper with fresh water to the selected animal. It drinks after delivery.
tip.pet: Click to send your keeper to cuddle this animal and improve its happiness.
tip.clean: Click to send your keeper to remove droppings or litter from the selected tile.
tip.clear: Click to send your keeper to remove weeds, a stone or a stump. The cleared tile becomes usable.
tip.repair: Click to send your keeper to repair the damaged starter fence.
tip.walk: Click to send your keeper to this clear tile. A connected route must be free.
tip.refill: Click to send your keeper with one portion from your food store to this feeder. Hungry animals eat the stored food themselves.
tip.refillWater: Click to send your keeper to fill this trough with fresh water. Thirsty animals drink by themselves.
tip.findAnimal: Click to select your first animal and show feeding, water and cuddle actions.
tip.findWeed: Click to select reachable weeds. Then Clear sends your keeper to remove them.
tip.findDirt: Click to select reachable droppings or litter. Then Clean sends your keeper to tidy it.
tip.findFeeder: Click to select a feeder and see stored food. Refill sends one portion there with your keeper.
tip.findWater: Click to select a water trough. Fill water trough sends your keeper to refill it.
tip.start: Click to start your zoo with the chosen animal, free food and no coins.
tip.pause: Click to pause or continue time. You can plan your zoo while paused.
tip.speed: Click to cycle between normal, relaxed and faster simulation speed.
tip.help: Click for short instructions. Open Show me the steps when you want detailed help.
tip.settings: Click to change language, sound and music, or save and restore your zoo.
tip.gate: Click to open or close your zoo. Open gates welcome paying visitors; closing gives you quiet care time.
tip.expand: Click to buy two more rows of rough land. The displayed coin price is charged once.
tip.emergency: Click for a small free food supply when stores are low. Then Feed or Refill a feeder.
tip.zoomIn: Click to look closer at the zoo. The mouse wheel also zooms.
tip.zoomOut: Click to see more of your zoo at once.
tip.rotate: Click to turn the camera a quarter turn and see behind objects.
tip.save: Click to save this zoo in this browser now. Automatic saving also runs every 10 seconds.
tip.export: Click to put a backup in the save-data box. Copy all its text somewhere safe.
tip.import: Paste a backup into the save-data box, then click to restore that zoo. It replaces the current zoo.
tip.reset: Click to choose whether to replace this zoo with a new one. Export a backup first to keep it.
tip.confirmReset: Click to choose a new starter. Starting the new zoo replaces the previous save.
tip.cancelReset: Click to keep your current zoo and close this question.
tip.need: A tick means this habitat need is met. A circle means improve it with ground, space, fences or care objects.
tip.stats: These show your coins, unlocked zoo stars, current guests and animal happiness. Care and improvements help your zoo grow.
tip.animal: This shows the animal and its habitat. Good food, water, affection and clean space make it happier.
tip.input.ticket: Drag to set admission. The face and recommended price show what visitors find fair; high prices reduce arrivals.
tip.input.sound: Drag to set sound-effect volume. Zero mutes effects without changing music.
tip.input.music: Drag to set calm background-music volume. Zero mutes music without changing effects.
tip.repairStarter: Click to send your keeper to repair the damaged starter fence.
tip.refillAnimal: Click to send your keeper with one portion from your food store to this feeder. Hungry animals eat the stored food themselves.
ui.tasksDone: All tasks complete! Keep growing your zoo.
tip.nextSong: Click to skip immediately to the next of five calm songs. Set Music above zero to hear it.
steps.clear: 1. Open Inspect. 2. Click Clear to find weeds. 3. Click Clear again. Your keeper walks over and removes the weeds, freeing a tile.
steps.repair: 1. Open Inspect. 2. Click Repair fence. Your keeper walks to the starter fence and straightens its broken rails. Wait until Ready appears.
steps.feed: 1. Click Animals in Inspect to select your friend. 2. Check its food type and food store. 3. Click Feed. If food is missing, buy that food or use Free emergency food first. Your keeper must deliver it.
steps.open: 1. Open Inspect. 2. Click Open zoo. 3. Visitors arrive on connected paths and pay admission. Keep your animal happy to encourage donations.
steps.bench: 1. Earn 5 coins. 2. Open Build → Objects → Bench. 3. Click a clear tile beside a connected path. Tired guests rest here and stay longer.
steps.happy: 1. Feed, water and pet your animal. 2. Keep paths and the enclosure clean. 3. Add benches and play equipment near paths. Three visitors need to become happy; watch their smiles.
steps.donations: 1. Keep animals fed, watered and happy. 2. Let guests watch from connected paths near the enclosure. 3. Add a nearby bench and donation box. Happy visitors sometimes donate; collect 20 donation coins in total.
steps.popcorn: 1. Earn 12 coins. 2. Open Build → Shops → Popcorn stall. 3. Click a clear tile beside a connected path. Hungry guests buy automatically. A vendor later improves sales.
steps.secondAnimal: 1. Earn coins for an unlocked animal. 2. Build a closed enclosure with enough space; include a gate, food and water. 3. Open Animals, select a species, then click a free tile inside. A transporter celebrates the arrival!
steps.stars: 1. Add another animal species. 2. Improve habitats and animal happiness. 3. Add useful buildings, clean your zoo and delight guests. Zoo stars rise with these improvements and unlock more species.
steps.finished: All ten tasks are done. Keep building habitats, welcoming animals and making your zoo a happy place.
tip.repairDone: The starter fence is already repaired. Your keeper can now help with other care tasks.
message.plant: Your keeper is bringing flowers to plant.
tip.plant: Click to send your keeper to plant flowers on this clear tile for 2 coins. Flowers appear when planting finishes and make your zoo more attractive.
tip.cancelTask: Stop your keeper’s current job so you can choose another. Undelivered food and reserved planting coins are returned.
message.cancelled: Ready for a new job. Unused food and planting coins were returned.
